candidates.title: IceFormer: Accelerated Inference with Long-Sequence Transformers on CPUs
candidates.reason: Training-free CPU inference acceleration for long-sequence Transformers, including LLaMA-class models, with substantial measured speedups.

candidates.title: KV Cache is 1 Bit Per Channel: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Coupled Quantization
candidates.reason: KV-cache coupled quantization exploiting cross-channel dependence to preserve quality at extremely low bit widths down to one bit.

candidates.title: You Only Cache Once: Decoder-Decoder Architectures for Language Models
candidates.reason: YOCO architecture shares global KV state across decoder layers, reducing inference memory and improving prefill latency/throughput at long context.

candidates.title: Boosting Multimodal Large Language Models with Visual Tokens Withdrawal for Rapid Inference
candidates.reason: Plug-in multimodal inference optimization that removes redundant visual tokens in deeper layers and reports over 40% compute reduction.
